about: Known terms of archives, shipped with strom: a host (with its subdomains) and the level its published terms give automated access — allowed < restricted (unknown: the terms not found, as restricted) < manual < forbidden. A level here is a confirmed one: a connector's allowed needs no person's word, a connector taken over no confirmation; the strictest of all that is known still holds (a connector, the tree's archive, robots.txt, a refusal stricter than this keeps it stricter). browserOnly: only a person's browser goes there. pace: the site's Crawl-delay, a floor (only ever slower). disallow: paths no automated request takes. scope: what the level covers. quoteFrom robots: the quote is the site's robots.txt (its address in terms), not its terms of use. automatedUse: the terms quoted expressly allow automated use (open data, any use, an interface for programs) — a Disallow of the site's robots.txt alone then yields, carefully (one request after another, at least its Crawl-delay, strom's User-Agent, its limits as ever); never a robots.txt that names AI agents, never the paths of disallow here. Only public terms, quoted word for word from the address given, on the day checked; a release adds an archive.
